design.source_pool_partition: stratified 80/20 private source split, globally disjoint training and held-out sources
design.naming: K=C/M; one protected aggregate; rho fraction .5
design.public_baseline: fixed observed-count region matching; frozen comparator from completed development study
design.candidate_family: restricted regional demonstration: public count match; eight existing joint weights; fixed private centered and coverage
design.candidate_choice: exact LOO accuracy; public-first fixed ties; no external public validation labels
design.verification_target: finite actual held-out cohort mean candidate-minus-public-baseline utility; not unseen-population or per-client benefit
design.gain_report: round half-up s*(1+paired gain)/2; integer sensitivity s
design.class_report: C x 4 joint correctness histogram per client normalized by 120, exact largest-remainder integer simplex; squared sensitivity 2*s*s
design.validation_noise: independent exact distributed discrete Gaussian shares for each of the two validation reports
design.gain_policy: private candidate selected AND gain lower > 0, otherwise public baseline
design.class_checked_policy: gain policy AND positive simultaneous lower class recall in every class, otherwise public baseline
design.private_local_heldout_utility: offline context only; never a selection/validation input
design.test_labels: loaded only after candidate selection, protected validation and publication decisions
design.privacy_counterfactual_scope: one label set, one cohort, one total epsilon; all research cases are separate deployments
